SIAM Organises its First National EV Charging Day: Advancing the growth and readiness of EV Charging Infrastructure

SIAM Organises its First National EV Charging Day: Advancing the growth and readiness of EV Charging Infrastructure ~ 1st Growth & Readiness for EV Infrastructure Dialogue (GRID 2026) explores strategies for a robust, accessible and future-ready EV charging network New Delhi, 20th November 2026: The Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers (SIAM) with the support of Ministry of Heavy Industries, Government of India organised its first National EV Charging Day – 1st Growth & Readiness for EV Infrastructure Dialogue (GRID 2026) today in New Delhi, under its Electrification (विधुतीकरण) initiative. With the theme ‘Powering India’s EV Future: Strategic Pathways for Scalable Charging Infrastructure’, the event brought together policymakers, senior government officials, state representatives and industry leaders who deliberated on strategies for accelerating the development of a robust, accessible and scalable electric vehicle (EV) charging ecosystem in India.

  • 03-Nov-2026
  • New Delhi
SIAM promotes road safety awareness among school students through 12th inter-school competition

The Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers (SIAM) today concluded the12th SAFE Mobility Inter-School Competition on road safety after a week-long series of online and offline activities. Organised at Gyan Mandir Public School, Naraina Vihar, New Delhi, the competition brought together students from schools across the city to showcase their understanding of road safety and responsible road behaviour. Organised as part of SIAM’s 'सुरक्षित यात्रा (SAFE JOURNEY) initiative with support from India Yamaha Motor’s CSR funds, the annual competition aims to nurture road safety awareness among young minds.

  • 15-Oct-2026
  • New Delhi
Auto Industry Sales Performance of Q2:FY2027 (July–September 2026)

Key Highlights from Q2 (July–September 2026) a) Passenger vehicles • Passenger Vehicle sales stood at 1.36 million units in Q2 of 2026–27, registering a growth of 30.7% compared to Q2 of 2025–26. • The Utility Vehicle (UV) sub-segment continued to dominate the PV market, accounting for 68% of total PV sales. UV sales grew by 34.2% in Q2 of 2026-27, compared with Q2 of 2025-26. Passenger car sales also recorded a strong double-digit growth rate of 24.9% during the quarter. • Improved affordability post GST 2.0, lower base of last year, new vehicle technologies including alternate fuels and EVs besides strong financing support have helped impressive growth of passenger vehicles. With rural demand holding and the festive off take being healthy, passenger vehicles sales have registered healthy growth.

  • 18-Sep-2026
  • Gandhinagar, Gujarat
A Collective Drive Towards Safer Roads: 27th SAFE Annual Convention

Gandhinagar, 18th September 2026: Reaffirming the shared responsibility of building safer roads and a safer mobility ecosystem, the Society for Automotive Fitness & Environment (SAFE), an initiative of the Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers (SIAM), hosted the 27th SAFE Annual Convention, under the Safe Journey initiative in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. Themed ‘Safe Journey: A Collective Journey Towards Safety with Responsibility’ in association with Transport Department and Gujarat Road Safety Authority, Government of Gujarat. The convention brought together policymakers, industry leaders and road safety experts to drive dialogue on responsible road use, stronger safety practices and collaborative action towards safer mobility in India. Chief Guest at the convention, Mr Pravin Gordhanji Mali, Minister of State, Forests and Environment, Climate Change, Transport, Govt. of Gujarat said, “Building a culture of respect on our roads is essential if we want to reduce fatalities and make mobility safer. Awareness, behaviour and civic sense are just as important as technology in improving road safety.”
